output.question: What is Sysco's annual revenue?
output.answer: Sysco's latest reported annual revenue was $84.553 billion for fiscal year 2026, which ended June 27, 2026. Sysco reported that fiscal-year sales increased 3.9% from $81.370 billion in fiscal 2025. This is the latest full fiscal year available as of November 11, 2026.

key_facts.fact: Sysco reported fiscal-year 2026 sales (revenue) of $84.553 billion, or $84,553 million.
Fiscal-year 2026 sales increased 3.9% from fiscal-year 2025 sales of $81.370 billion.

passages.quote: Sysco Corporation (NYSE:SYY) (“Sysco” or the “company”) today announced financial results for its 13-week fourth fiscal quarter and its fiscal year ended June 27, 2026.
Sales for fiscal year 2026 increased 3.9% to $84.6 billion.

caveats: Sysco reports on a fiscal-year basis rather than a calendar-year basis; the latest fiscal year ended June 27, 2026.
The release rounds the figure to $84.6 billion in narrative text; the consolidated statement reports the precise amount as $84,553 million.
